title: fix(clear-all): apply excludeAttribute correctly with clearsQuery
body:
## Initial bug

When clearsQuery and excludeAttributes are used together, we can clear the excluded attributes when the query is not empty

## Reproducing the issue with the current InstantSearch

http://extra-small-group.surge.sh

 - select a brand (note that the clearall button does not activate)
 - add some text in the search box (clear all button is activable)
 - click clear all
 - the query AND the brand are cleared

brand should not be cleared.

## Notes 

The problem is that fixing only this initial bug had an impact on `currentRefinedValues`. Both widget use the same utility function to provide the clear all feature but they have two opposite list system for excluding attributes: one is a white list, and the other a black list.

This patch refactors the utilities, baking the support of the two types of list in a single place. 

A next step for this could be to use a single connnector for current refined values and clear all widgets.
